steps.en: Install the app — Docker Compose stack or pip
steps.zh: 装起应用——Docker Compose 栈或 pip
steps.code: docker compose up -d · pip install local-deep-research

steps.en: Bring up the web app alongside bundled Ollama and SearXNG containers
steps.zh: 应用连同内置的 Ollama、SearXNG 容器一起拉起，打开 Web UI

steps.en: In Settings pick the langgraph-agent strategy and point the LLM at your local model
steps.zh: 在设置里选 langgraph-agent 策略，把 LLM 指向本地模型

steps.en: Per question, the agent decides which engines to search (web, arXiv, PubMed…) and keeps reading
steps.zh: 由 agent 自主决定搜哪些引擎并持续追读，直到证据足够

steps.en: Synthesizes a cited report into your per-user AES-256 SQLCipher database
steps.zh: 生成带引用的报告，写入按用户加密的 SQLCipher 库

value.en: Multi-engine cited research running entirely on hardware you own — nothing has to leave your network
value.zh: 多引擎、带引用的研究全程跑在你自己的机器上——数据不必离开你的网络
